elements.requirement: A demand for the payment of a service charge must be accompanied by a summary of the rights and obligations of tenants of dwellings in relation to service charges.
elements.quote: A demand for the payment of a service charge must be accompanied by a summary of the rights and obligations of tenants of dwellings in relation to service charges.

elements.requirement: The Secretary of State is permitted to make regulations that prescribe requirements regarding the form and content of summaries of rights and obligations.
elements.quote: The Secretary of State may make regulations prescribing requirements as to the form and content of such summaries of rights and obligations.

elements.requirement: A tenant is permitted to withhold payment of a demanded service charge if the demand is not accompanied by the required summary of the rights and obligations of tenants of dwellings.
elements.quote: A tenant may withhold payment of a service charge which has been demanded from him if subsection (1) is not complied with in relation to the demand.

elements.requirement: Where a tenant withholds a service charge due to non-compliance with the summary requirement, any terms of the lease concerning non-payment or late payment of service charges have no effect for the duration of that withholding period.
elements.quote: any provisions of the lease relating to non-payment or late payment of service charges do not have effect in relation to the period for which he so withholds it.

elements.requirement: Regulations prescribing requirements as to the form and content of summaries of rights and obligations may make different provision for different purposes.
elements.quote: Regulations under subsection (2) may make different provision for different purposes.

elements.requirement: Regulations prescribing requirements as to the form and content of summaries of rights and obligations must be made by statutory instrument and are subject to annulment pursuant to a resolution of either House of Parliament.
elements.quote: shall be made by statutory instrument which shall be subject to annulment in pursuance of a resolution of either House of Parliament.
